title: The first minute
feature: First launch and the first minute
summary: On the first visit, the title leads to the first real move in under 30 seconds. The first tap of the app is an Archer shot over a pawn; then the board grows into a full game.
problem: Today the title shows three buttons: Learn the pieces, Play and Workshop. A new player must choose a path before the game shows what makes it new.
idea: One button on the real title: Take your first shot. The player shoots once on a close view of the real board, and the view pulls back into a full game against the Beginner computer. No account, no tour, no setup.

borrows.what: The first action teaches the rule. The words only point to it.
The first match starts at once, with a deal chosen for a new player.
One clear action on a calm scene, then the camera pulls back to show the whole world.
Option B: a short task first, then a free choice of what comes next.

options.name: Take your first shot

options.name: Learn the new pieces
options.summary: The advisors' title: Learn first, Play second. One Archer lesson, then Play a game or Next: the Beast.

recommendation: A. The first tap shows the new game, and the player is in a real game with no choice to make. Play stays one quiet tap away, and the lessons stay in the Guide.
notes: First visit only. Later visits open on Continue or Play (see feat-home).
Try it: Take your first shot, tap the Archer, tap the pawn. A tap or a key ends the short pause. That tap does not play in the new game.
The shot leaves a thin gold trail over the pawn and a ring under the Archer. So a still frame shows that she shoots over pieces and does not move. Both go when the board grows.

The first deal is deal 83 (QRNAKBBS): one Archer, one Beast and chess pieces only. These are the two starter pieces in docs/PROGRESSION.md. The shot board is White's real home ranks of this deal, so the Archer starts the game on the square where she shot.
The pull-back is the one strong moment (640 ms). The board's letters and numbers come back during it. Reduced motion shows the full board at once.
Play on the title and Skip both start the same game at once, with no setup.
Limits: Menu, Workshop and Next: the Beast show a short message only. The chosen deal needs the owner's yes.
